unexpressed.span: with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos
unexpressed.why: The onset of the act (the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned), from which the side-by-side observations the recognition reads are counted, needs the alignment of a's and b's headings at past observations. No name the record claims denotes it: rel.bearing gives b's direction in a's frame, rel.longitudinal_overlap the shared length of the projections, and drv.interaction.overtake_pass holds only at the recognition and exposes neither its onset nor the alignment. rel.same_direction would denote it but is not claimed; counting from the last ahead or the last behind observation instead would be an approximation, not the contract.
